## 简体中文

- 新增 SFTP 文件管理器：路径提示与补全、文件树、多文件标签、文件/文件夹上传下载，以及同一服务器和跨服务器复制粘贴。单击目录展开/折叠，点击选中行右侧箭头进入目录。
- 支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 原生拖入上传和拖出下载；改进拖动过程中外部下载与树内移动的切换、目标高亮和可放置区域。移动及删除操作均需确认。
- 新增传输明细面板，显示进度、大小、已传字节、速度、耗时和预计剩余时间；右键可暂停、继续、取消、失败重试及处理同名冲突，当前应用会话内支持断线重连续传。修正右键菜单位置，速度及预计剩余时间每秒刷新一次。
- 文本编辑支持最大 5 MiB 的 UTF-8 / 带 BOM 的 UTF-16 文件，提供语法高亮、编辑右键菜单和查找替换。修复深色主题及搜索面板语言适配，关闭当前行背景高亮，保留选区高亮。远程内容变化时阻止直接覆盖。
- 修复训练日志中单独 CR 回车及混合换行的显示，编辑、保存和撤销保留原始换行符；图片预览支持 Ctrl + 滚轮缩放。
- 终端中识别出的 HTTP/HTTPS 链接可通过系统默认浏览器打开。
- “我的空间”仅统计当前用户可访问范围内的本人文件，跳过权限不足的目录和无法访问的 FUSE 挂载点；`/tmp` 缺失或不可访问时按零计入合计，显示 `—` 并禁用清理按钮。
- 精简工作台和三个小工具中的重复标题、说明及装饰，面板宽度随窗口扩展并保持固定边距；移除显卡监测装饰折线及对应状态文字，保留实际监测和刷新功能。
- 更新中英文说明与工作台预览，兼容仓库更名后的更新地址，并保留旧版应用升级所需的下载链接。

## English

- Add an SFTP file manager with path suggestions/completion, a file tree, multiple tabs, file/folder uploads and downloads, and copying within or between servers. Click folders to expand/collapse; use the selected row's right-arrow button to enter a directory.
- Support native drag-in uploads and drag-out downloads on Windows, macOS and Linux. Improve switching between external downloads and moves within the tree, destination highlighting and accepted drop regions. Moves and deletions require confirmation.
- Add a transfer panel with progress, size, transferred bytes, speed, elapsed time and ETA. Its context menu provides pause, resume, cancellation, retry and name-conflict resolution, with reconnect/resume support during the current app session. Fix menu positioning and refresh speed/ETA once per second.
- Edit UTF-8 and BOM-marked UTF-16 files up to 5 MiB with syntax highlighting, an editing context menu and search/replace. Fix dark-theme styling and search-panel localization, remove the active-line background while keeping selection highlighting, and prevent overwriting externally changed files.
- Correctly display CR-only and mixed line endings in training logs, preserving original separators through editing, saving and undo. Add Ctrl + mouse-wheel zoom for image previews.
- Open recognized HTTP/HTTPS terminal links in the system's default browser.
- Count owned files only within accessible directories, skipping permission-denied paths and inaccessible FUSE mounts. A missing or inaccessible `/tmp` contributes zero, displays `—` and disables cleanup.
- Simplify repeated headings, descriptions and decorations across the workspace and all three tools. Panels expand with the window while retaining fixed margins. Remove the decorative GPU sparkline and its status text while preserving monitoring and refresh controls.
- Update both READMEs and workspace previews; accept the renamed repository's update URLs while retaining download links compatible with earlier app versions.
